# Roy Gardner

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 ch.Dawn P29](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0029)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Roy is described as adorably handsome, possessing a deep, black, velvety smile. He also features glorious dark eyes that complement a pleading voice.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 ch.Dawn P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044)_

## Personality

Roy Gardner is an exceptionally handsome, clever, and wealthy young man who is also considered good. He is characterized by his pleading, delightful voice and his unfailing, deferential courtesy, which leaves a strongly favorable impression on those he meets.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Dawn P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044)_

## History

Roy Gardner left college and went abroad with his mother after her health failed. Two years later, he rescued [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) during a rainstorm, walked her home, and sent her roses, initiating a romance with her. Over the course of their time together at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), he escorted her to events and eventually introduced her to his family, with his sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) bonding warmly with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). However, at the harbor pavilion, Roy proposed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), only for her to realize she did not love him and reject his proposal, effectively ending their relationship.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Charming P0](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0000), [v3 ch.Charming P2](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0002), [v3 ch.Charming P3](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0003), [v3 ch.Charming P4](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0004), [v3 ch.Charming P5](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0005), [v3 ch.Charming P6](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0006), +245 more_

## Quotes

> "That ought to be sufficient introduction. My name is Royal Gardner. And you are the Miss Shirley who read the Tennyson paper at the Philomathic the other evening, aren’t you?"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P36](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0036)

> "I feel as if I didn’t belong anywhere yet. I put in my Freshman and Sophomore years at Redmond two years ago. I’ve been in Europe ever since. Now I’ve come back to finish my Arts course."
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P38](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0038)

> "I can’t understand it—I can’t believe you are not the woman I’ve believed you to be. But reproaches are idle between us. You are the only woman I can ever love. I thank you for your friendship, at least. Good-bye, Anne."
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Dawn P32](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0032)

> "So we are classmates as well as collegemates. I am reconciled to the loss of the years that the locust has eaten"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P40](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0040)

> "Pardon me—may I offer you the shelter of my umbrella?"
>
> — Roy Gardner — [v3 ch.Charming P28](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0028)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--roy-gardner.md)

Roy courted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) during their time at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), regularly sending her violets and writing to her twice a week. Though [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially weighed her feelings for Roy alongside her thoughts of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), she ultimately rejected Roy's marriage proposal at the harbor pavilion after realizing she did not truly love him. Their relationship ended with Roy's failed proposal, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) distressed over the painful turn of events.

- Romantically involved with — college suitor who writes to her twice a week  <sub>[v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 ch.Confidences P35](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0035), [v3 ch.Evening P22](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0022), +1 more</sub>

### [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dorothy--roy-gardner.md)

[Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) is Roy's friendly sister who came to visit him along with the rest of their family. During this unexpected visit, [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) connected warmly with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), the object of Roy's affections. Her warm interaction with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helped ease the flustered atmosphere caused by the family arriving a day earlier than expected.

- Sibling of — sister  <sub>[v3 ch.Gardners’Call P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024), [v3 ch.Weddings P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)</sub>
